selection_rule: pre-registered scale-sensitivity arm: keep the eligible WildGuard cap and fit balanced Nemotron proportionally
notes: The builder requests every normalized-valid WildGuard row, then clamps to post-cleaning eligible complete prompt groups.
Nemotron selection keeps complete upstream IDs across languages and targets near-equal counts over the nine selected languages.
This is the main scale arm selected from the matched 80k study; it is not a claim that the ratio is globally optimal.
